title: Food court connected to airport via tunnels?
content: The title basically says it, last night the food court connected directly to the airport via tunnels for me. I was wondering if anyone similar experience in their mall world? Also, it was fun skating through the tunnels last night. I ended up going to a food court shop that sold donuts and hot dogs. While I was ordering, somebody stole a lady’s red bag while she was eating. I chased down the thief and the lady was grateful. I’m sorry if I’m babbling I was just remembering my experience last night. Does a food court connected to the airport via circular tunnels sound familiar to anyone else?
